## Scrub

Removes **GPS and identifying metadata** from photos before apps receive them for sending — so your location and device details don't ride along with a shared image. Orientation and color profile are preserved; JPEG and HEIC supported.

Modes and a per-app exclude list in Settings → Scrub.

**A11 and older only for now** (iPhone X / 8 and earlier). Earlier builds of this tweak put **A12 and newer devices** (iPhone XS / XR and later) into safe mode: their A12+ part was built with the wrong format. This update is arm64-only, and it refuses to install on A12+ devices so nobody else is affected.

- **On an A12+ device with it installed?** Update or uninstall it in Sileo (safe mode still lets you open Sileo).
- A12+ support needs a new build toolchain and an A12+ tester. If you can help, open a [GitHub issue](https://github.com/Jond-ie/repo/issues).

- Covers the common photo-pick paths (Photos library, the system picker). Coverage can vary for apps using custom pickers — feedback on which apps work welcome.
- Requires **AltList** (com.opa334.altlist) for the app list, plus PreferenceLoader; hooks run via ellekit/Substrate.
- Tested on an **iPhone 8 Plus (A11, arm64)** with iOS 16.7. **A11 and older only for now** (see Device Support).
